title: A New Strategy for Prosecuting School Shootings

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯《DealBook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的DealBook峰会上现场采访几位商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的领导人，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、扎伊兰·蒙达尼等许多人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 届时，您可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch, free, at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们将在11月18日通过nytimes.com对部分采访进行免费直播，供所有人观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果您还不是订阅用户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得一个月的免费访问权限，阅读我们所有的报道。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望您能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 您一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: Last week...
sentences.zh: 上周……

sentences.en: We are following the breaking news of a shooting at a high school in Oxford, Michigan, outside of Detroit.
sentences.zh: 我们正在追踪底特律郊外密歇根州牛津市一所高中发生枪击案的突发新闻。

sentences.en: When the shooting was over at Oxford High School in suburban Detroit...
sentences.zh: 当底特律郊区牛津高中的枪击事件结束后……

sentences.en: The four who lost their lives are 17-year-old Justin Schilling, 14-year-old Hannah St. Juliana,
sentences.zh: 四名遇难者分别是17岁的贾斯汀·席林、14岁的汉娜·圣朱利亚纳、

sentences.en: 17-year-old Madison Baldwin, and 16-year-old Tate Meyer.
sentences.zh: 17岁的麦迪逊·鲍德温和16岁的泰特·迈耶。

sentences.en: The suspected shooter is a sophomore, a 15-year-old classmate.
sentences.zh: 嫌疑枪手是一名15岁的同班同学，读十年级。

sentences.en: He is in custody this morning.
sentences.zh: 他今天早上已被拘留。

sentences.en: Local prosecutors decided on a novel legal strategy that would extend criminal culpability beyond the gunman himself.
sentences.zh: 当地检察官决定采取一种新颖的法律策略，将刑事责任范围扩大到枪手本人之外。

sentences.en: I spoke with my colleague, national correspondent Jack Healy, about what's behind that strategy and whether it could become a national model.
sentences.zh: 我与我的同事、全国记者杰克·希利谈论了该策略背后的考量，以及它是否会成为全国性的范例。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, December 7th.
sentences.zh: 今天是12月7日，星期二。

sentences.en: Jack, you have covered a depressingly large number of mass shootings, and we know that because we've talked to you about a lot of them here on The Daily.
sentences.zh: 杰克，你报道过令人沮丧的大量大规模枪击事件，我们知道这一点，因为我们在《每日新闻》上和你讨论过很多次。

sentences.en: So I'm curious what you were thinking when you learned about this latest shooting in Michigan.
sentences.zh: 所以我很好奇，当你得知密歇根州这起最新枪击案时，你在想什么？

sentences.en: I think the response from a journalist like me is not too dissimilar from that of the American public, which is, my God, not again.
sentences.zh: 我想像我这样的记者的反应与美国公众没什么不同，那就是：天哪，又来了。

sentences.en: But after that, I and my colleagues had to get to work.
sentences.zh: 但那之后，我和同事们必须开始工作了。

sentences.en: So we started calling the local law enforcement officials.
sentences.zh: 所以我们开始联系当地执法官员。

sentences.en: We reached out to witnesses on the ground, students who had fled from the shooting,
sentences.zh: 我们联系了现场目击者，那些从枪击现场逃出来的学生，

sentences.en: all of the things that, unfortunately, we have gotten too practiced at doing in the wake of these horrible shootings.
sentences.zh: 所有这些事情，不幸的是，我们在这些可怕的枪击事件发生后已经做得太熟练了。

sentences.en: But in this case, there was something kind of extraordinary.
sentences.zh: 但在这种情况下，有一些非常不同寻常的事情。

sentences.en: The local prosecutor suggested very quickly that she was considering charging not just the shooter, but also his parents.
sentences.zh: 当地检察官很快表示，她正在考虑不仅起诉枪手，还要起诉他的父母。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And what did you make of that?
sentences.zh: 你对此有何看法？

sentences.en: Well, to me, it was remarkable and something that I had almost never heard before.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这非常引人注目，是我几乎从未听说过的事情。

sentences.en: There are always questions surrounding the parents and family of a mass shooting suspect,
sentences.zh: 围绕大规模枪击嫌疑人的父母和家庭总是有很多疑问，

sentences.en: questions about how could they have let this happen, what warning signs did they miss, did they do something wrong.
sentences.zh: 关于他们怎么能让这种事发生，他们错过了什么警告信号，他们是否做错了什么。

sentences.en: But they are rarely held criminally responsible, and that's what is so different and so unique about this case.
sentences.zh: 但他们很少被追究刑事责任，这就是本案如此不同且独特的地方。

sentences.en: Good afternoon.
sentences.zh: 下午好。

sentences.en: I'm Karen McDonald.
sentences.zh: 我是凯伦·麦克唐纳。

sentences.en: I'm the Oakland County prosecutor.
sentences.zh: 我是奥克兰县检察官。

sentences.en: The prosecutor, Karen McDonald, made the decision to file charges against the mother and father of the suspected 15-year-old school shooter.
sentences.zh: 检察官凯伦·麦克唐纳决定对这名15岁嫌疑枪手的母亲和父亲提起诉讼。

sentences.en: The charges are as follows.
sentences.zh: 指控如下。

sentences.en: James Crumbly is charged with four counts of involuntary manslaughter.
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯·克伦布利被控四项过失杀人罪。

sentences.en: Jennifer Crumbly is also charged with four counts of involuntary manslaughter.
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗·克伦布利也被控四项过失杀人罪。

sentences.en: So, in effect, she was holding them partially criminally responsible for the shooting that their son has been charged with carrying out.
sentences.zh: 所以，实际上，她认为他们对儿子被指控实施的枪击事件负有部分刑事责任。

sentences.en: While the shooter was the one who entered the high school and pulled the trigger, there are other individuals who contributed to the events on November 30th,
sentences.zh: 虽然是枪手本人进入高中并扣动了扳机，但还有其他人促成了11月30日发生的事件，

sentences.en: and it's my intention to hold them accountable as well.
sentences.zh: 我的意图是也要让他们承担责任。

sentences.en: On Friday, she held an extraordinary news conference in which she stepped in front of the cameras
sentences.zh: 周五，她举行了一场非同寻常的新闻发布会，她走到摄像机前，

sentences.en: and laid out a detailed case against the two parents here, James and Jennifer Crumbly.
sentences.zh: 详细阐述了针对这对父母——詹姆斯和詹妮弗·克伦布利——的指控。

sentences.en: It begins on the day after Thanksgiving.
sentences.zh: 这一切始于感恩节后的第二天。

sentences.en: On November 26th, 2021, James Crumbly purchased a Sig Sauer 9mm model...
sentences.zh: 2021年11月26日，詹姆斯·克伦布利购买了一把西格绍尔9毫米型号……

sentences.en: The 15-year-old suspect's father took him along to a local gun shop in Michigan to buy a 9mm semi-automatic Sig Sauer.
sentences.zh: 这名15岁嫌疑人的父亲带着他去密歇根州当地一家枪店买了一把9毫米半自动西格绍尔手枪。

sentences.en: A store employee confirms that Ethan Crumbly was present with James at the time of the purchase.
sentences.zh: 店员证实，伊桑·克伦布利在购买时与詹姆斯在一起。

sentences.en: Prosecutors say this gun was not for either of the parents.
sentences.zh: 检察官称，这把枪并不是给父母任何一方使用的。

sentences.en: On or about November 26th, 2021, Ethan Crumbly's social media posts reveal photos of the semi-automatic handgun, along with the caption,
sentences.zh: 2021年11月26日左右，伊桑·克伦布利的社交媒体帖子显示了这把半自动手枪的照片，并配文：

sentences.en: Just got my new beauty today, including a emoji with hearts.
sentences.zh: 今天刚得到我的新宝贝，还带了一个爱心表情符号。

sentences.en: Instead, it was actually a Christmas gift for the 15-year-old suspected gunman.
sentences.zh: 相反，这实际上是给这名15岁嫌疑枪手的圣诞礼物。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Subsequent to the purchase of that weapon, one of Jennifer Crumbly's social media posts on about 11-27-21 read, quote,
sentences.zh: 在购买该武器后，詹妮弗·克伦布利在2021年11月27日左右的一篇社交媒体帖子中写道，引用如下：

sentences.en: Mom and Sunday testing out his new Christmas present, end quote.
sentences.zh: 妈妈和儿子在测试他的新圣诞礼物，引用结束。

sentences.en: And furthermore, prosecutors say that the parents did not keep the gun in a locked safe or in a secure location out of the reach of their son.
sentences.zh: 此外，检察官称，这对父母并没有将枪支锁在保险箱或儿子拿不到的安全地方。

sentences.en: Further investigation revealed that the Sig Sauer 9mm handgun purchased by James Crumbly was stored unlocked in a drawer in James and Jennifer's bedroom.
sentences.zh: 进一步调查显示，詹姆斯·克伦布利购买的西格绍尔9毫米手枪被存放在詹姆斯和詹妮弗卧室的一个抽屉里，没有上锁。

sentences.en: Okay, so what happens next, according to the prosecutor?
sentences.zh: 好的，那么根据检察官的说法，接下来会发生什么？

sentences.en: The day before the shooting, one of the suspect's teachers notices him conducting a search online for ammunition while he's at school.
sentences.zh: 枪击案发生前一天，嫌疑人的一名老师注意到他在学校上网搜索弹药。

sentences.en: Jennifer Crumbly was contacted via voicemail by school personnel regarding that son's inappropriate internet search.
sentences.zh: 学校工作人员通过语音信箱联系了詹妮弗·克伦布利，告知她儿子的不当互联网搜索行为。

sentences.en: School personnel indicate they followed that voicemail up with an email, but received no response from either parent.
sentences.zh: 学校工作人员表示，他们在语音留言后又发了一封电子邮件，但没有收到任何家长的回复。

sentences.en: The parents are notified, but instead of responding with alarm, prosecutors say the mother of the suspect almost seemed to make a joke out of this.
sentences.zh: 家长们得到了通知，但检察官说，嫌疑人的母亲非但没有表现出警觉，反而似乎把这当成了一个笑话。

sentences.en: Thereafter, Jennifer Crumbly exchanged text messages about the incident with her son on that day, stating,
sentences.zh: 此后，詹妮弗·克伦布利当天与儿子就此事互发短信，称：

sentences.en: Quote, LOL, I'm not mad at you.
sentences.zh: 引用：哈哈，我没生你的气。

sentences.en: You have to learn not to get caught, unquote.
sentences.zh: 你得学会别被抓住，引用结束。

sentences.en: So the mom's response to his search for ammunition is basically, do a better job of concealing that kind of search.
sentences.zh: 所以妈妈对他搜索弹药的反应基本上是：把那种搜索隐藏得更好一点。

sentences.en: That's what the prosecutors say, yes.
sentences.zh: 检察官就是这么说的，是的。

sentences.en: And things get even more disturbing the next day.
sentences.zh: 第二天事情变得更加令人不安。

sentences.en: One of the suspect's teachers found a note on his desk that contained a litany of incredibly disturbing and violent images.
sentences.zh: 嫌疑人的一名老师在他的桌子上发现了一张纸条，上面有一连串令人难以置信的、不安的暴力图像。

sentences.en: The note contained the following.
sentences.zh: 纸条内容如下。

sentences.en: A drawing of a semi-automatic handgun pointing at the words, quote,
sentences.zh: 一张半自动手枪的画，指向文字，引用：

sentences.en: The thoughts won't stop, help me, end quote.
sentences.zh: 这些想法停不下来，救救我，引用结束。

sentences.en: In another section of the note was a drawing of a bullet with the following words above that bullet, quote,
sentences.zh: 纸条的另一部分画着一颗子弹，子弹上方写着以下文字，引用：

sentences.en: And the teacher, understandably, was incredibly alarmed, and the suspect's parents were quickly called into the school for a meeting with, the suspect, the suspect, and counselors.
sentences.zh: 老师理所当然地感到非常震惊，嫌疑人的父母很快被叫到学校与嫌疑人及辅导员开会。

sentences.en: At the meeting, James and Jennifer Crumbly were shown the drawing and were advised that they were required to get their son into counseling within 48 hours.
sentences.zh: 在会议上，詹姆斯和詹妮弗·克伦布利看到了那幅画，并被告知他们必须在48小时内让儿子接受心理辅导。

sentences.en: Both James and Jennifer Crumbly failed to ask their son if he had his gun with him or where his gun was located
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯和詹妮弗·克伦布利都没有问儿子是否随身带着枪，或者枪在哪里，

sentences.en: and failed to inspect his backpack for the presence of the gun, which he had with him.
sentences.zh: 也没有检查他的背包里是否有枪，而枪当时就在他身上。

sentences.en: The subject comes up of him being basically taken out of class that day.
sentences.zh: 话题转到了他当天基本上要被带出教室的问题上。

sentences.en: But according to prosecutors, the parents resisted that idea.
sentences.zh: 但据检察官称，这对父母抵制了这个想法。

sentences.en: Instead, James and Jennifer Crumbly left the high school without their son.
sentences.zh: 相反，詹姆斯和詹妮弗·克伦布利在没有带走儿子的情况下离开了高中。

sentences.en: He was returned to the classroom.
sentences.zh: 他被送回了教室。

sentences.en: It's hard to understand the mind frame of the people inside of that meeting.
sentences.zh: 很难理解当时在会议室里的人的心态。

sentences.en: But I think what is very clear is that that was the last opportunity that school officials and this teenager's parents had
sentences.zh: 但我认为非常清楚的是，那是学校官员和这个青少年的父母最后的机会，

sentences.en: had to potentially head off the shooting, and it did not happen.
sentences.zh: 本可以阻止这场枪击，但并没有发生。

sentences.en: Instead, what happened is at about 12.50 that day, school security cameras record the suspect carrying his backpack into a bathroom
sentences.zh: 相反，当天下午12点50分左右，学校监控摄像头记录下嫌疑人背着背包走进洗手间，

sentences.en: and walking out armed with the very handgun that his parents had bought him as a Christmas present.
sentences.zh: 然后走出来，手里拿着他父母作为圣诞礼物买给他的那把手枪。

sentences.en: And according to prosecutors and law enforcement, as the suspect is walking through the halls, fatally shooting four of his classmates, wounding seven other people,
sentences.zh: 据检察官和执法部门称，当嫌疑人走过走廊，开枪打死四名同学，打伤另外七人时，

sentences.en: as other students are cowering in classrooms, word is starting to race through this small community that there's a school shooting at Oxford High School.
sentences.zh: 当其他学生在教室里蜷缩躲避时，消息开始在这个小社区传开，牛津高中发生了校园枪击案。

sentences.en: When the news of the active shooter at Oxford High School had been made public,
sentences.zh: 当牛津高中发生枪击事件的消息公开后，

sentences.en: Jennifer Crumbly texted to her son at 1.22 p.m., quote,
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗·克伦布利在下午1点22分给儿子发短信，引用：

sentences.en: Ethan, don't do it, end quote.
sentences.zh: 伊桑，别做傻事，引用结束。

sentences.en: This is before, hours before, any of the reporters covering this story were officially told about the suspect's name.
sentences.zh: 这发生在报道此事的记者们正式得知嫌疑人姓名之前的几个小时。

sentences.en: At 1.37 p.m., James Crumbly called 911, reporting that a gun was missing from his house, and he believed his son may be the shooter.
sentences.zh: 下午1点37分，詹姆斯·克伦布利拨打911报警，称家里丢了一把枪，他认为儿子可能是枪手。

sentences.en: So both parents seem to intuit, according to the prosecutor and their behavior, that their son is quite possibly the shooter.
sentences.zh: 所以根据检察官和他们的行为，这对父母似乎都直觉地认为他们的儿子很可能就是枪手。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Most parents in this community, I think, were terrified that their children could be among the victims of this shooting.
sentences.zh: 我想这个社区的大多数父母当时都非常害怕自己的孩子会成为这次枪击事件的受害者。

sentences.en: But according to prosecutors, these two parents quickly came to suspect that their son could be the suspect.
sentences.zh: 但据检察官称，这对父母很快就怀疑他们的儿子可能是嫌疑人。

sentences.en: And he was arrested shortly after the shooting that afternoon, in charge with terrorism and four counts of first-degree murder.
sentences.zh: 他在那天下午枪击事件发生后不久被捕，被控恐怖主义和四项一级谋杀罪。

sentences.en: I want to be really clear that these charges are intended to hold the individuals who contributed to this tragedy accountable,
sentences.zh: 我想明确一点，这些指控旨在让促成这场悲剧的个人承担责任，

sentences.en: and also send a message that gun owners have a responsibility.
sentences.zh: 同时也传达一个信息，即枪支拥有者负有责任。

sentences.en: When they fail to uphold that responsibility, there are serious and criminal consequences.
sentences.zh: 当他们未能履行这一责任时，就会产生严重的刑事后果。

sentences.en: So, Jack, to summarize the prosecutor's evidence for bringing these criminal charges against the parents of this alleged shooter and how they allegedly contribute to this shooting,
sentences.zh: 那么，杰克，总结一下检察官对这对涉嫌枪手的父母提起刑事指控的证据，以及他们如何涉嫌促成了这次枪击事件：

sentences.en: they buy the gun.
sentences.zh: 他们买了枪。

sentences.en: They make their son feel as if it's his.
sentences.zh: 他们让儿子觉得那是他的枪。

sentences.en: They are offering support to him when he's researching ammunition and even suggesting that he keep it secret.
sentences.zh: 当他在研究弹药时，他们为他提供支持，甚至建议他保密。

sentences.en: And when they learn he has very disturbing, violent thoughts that are connected to the gun, they don't pull him out of school.
sentences.zh: 当他们得知他有与枪支相关的非常令人不安的暴力想法时，他们没有让他退学。

sentences.en: And when the shooting starts, they see him on some gut level to kind of know that it's him.
sentences.zh: 当枪击开始时，他们从某种直觉层面意识到可能是他。

sentences.en: That's the case.
sentences.zh: 这就是案情。

sentences.en: Yeah, according to the prosecutor in this case, it all adds up to four charges of involuntary manslaughter against the mother and father.
sentences.zh: 是的，根据本案检察官的说法，这一切加起来就是对这对父母提出的四项过失杀人罪指控。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: But in the hours after the prosecutor wraps up her press conference, there was no quick arraignment.
sentences.zh: 但在检察官结束新闻发布会后的几个小时里，并没有迅速进行传讯。

sentences.en: There was no arrest of the parents.
sentences.zh: 这对父母没有被捕。

sentences.en: Instead, they disappeared.
sentences.zh: 相反，他们消失了。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道你需要订阅《时报》才能获取所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你可以免费探索《时报》一个月，而无需输入信用卡信息呢？
